Production five-second display cadence unchanged; instrumented runs can alter elapsed cadence and are work receipts only. Heap is unforced process sampling, not retained/peak/mobile acceptance.
result.limitations: Post-GC live-minus-empty renderer JS delta; current process metrics KB are not peak. Single replay/no early retained map. Complete Chromium GC scopes on the exact renderer thread can overlap; do not sum nested durations or equate GC with exclusive compiler CPU. Forced collection/tracing changes conditions; prior elapsed/paint/mobile/long-session acceptance is separate. Disposal also releases fixture bookkeeping, so its heap delta need not be zero.
